description: This file defines classes and macros for logging audio buffer data streams to disk, including BufLog, BufLogStream, and BufLogSingleton. It provides mechanisms to create, write to, pause, resume, and reset audio buffer logs, with configuration options and external dependencies on system headers.

classes.name: BufLogStream
classes.description: Handles individual audio buffer stream logging, including writing buffers, pausing, resuming, and finalizing streams.

classes.name: BufLog
classes.description: Manages multiple BufLogStream instances, providing methods to write buffers and reset all streams.

classes.name: BufLogSingleton
classes.description: Singleton pattern class providing global access to a single BufLog instance.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes an audio buffer to the specified stream.

methods.name: setPause
methods.description: Pauses or resumes a specific stream.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Stops and closes the stream, finalizing the log file.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Stops and closes all active streams, resetting the logging system.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BufLog.

methods.name: instanceExists
methods.description: Checks if the BufLog singleton instance exists.
